interface.longDescription:
Contentdrips is an AI graphic design tool for creating and publishing social media content.

Create graphics, carousels, and text posts for LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok—all in your own design and writing style. Contentdrips learns from your existing content to create visuals that match your brand and write posts that sound like you.

Create your content, customize the designs, and publish or schedule everything across your social channels from one place.
defaultPrompt: Create a 5-slide LinkedIn carousel on pricing freelance work in my brand style. Don't publish.
Turn this blog into an Instagram carousel and keep my template layout.

positive.prompt: What Contentdrips workspaces do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected account's workspaces with profile IDs. Do not create or publish anything.
Return a list of the test account's designs with names, IDs, and editor links. Do not auto-pick a template or start a render.

positive.description: Create a new branded carousel without a template ID
positive.prompt: Create a 5-slide LinkedIn carousel on how to price freelance work in my brand style. Don't publish — just give me the editor link.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the test workspace and a saved brand style, create a new carousel, and share the editor link. Do not render, schedule, or publish.

positive.description: Fill an existing template from a topic
positive.prompt: Use my saved template and fill a carousel on 3 mistakes new managers make. Keep the layout. Don't publish.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve a saved template, keep its layout, start the AI carousel fill, and report job status or export URLs. Do not publish.
Return scheduled posts for the connected account, or a clear empty state if none exist.

negative.prompt: Transfer $100 from my Contentdrips account to another user.
Publish this carousel to Facebook and X right now.
Delete every design in my account immediately.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, start subscriptions, or process payments. Users sign in to an existing Contentdrips account.

publication.release_notes: Listing copy and use-case skills for design, template fill, and social scheduling.
